paite: "Huan akha sagihna, ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; nou a ding in pengkul mut ni ahi ding ahi.
heading: Kum Thak Kut A Thillatte / (Lev 23.23-25)
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi: Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the ram,

paite: belamnou sagih, khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding in khelh thoihna kelpa khat toh.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

paite: Kha thak halmang thillat leh huai tangbuang thillatte, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, dawn thillat, ahihdan ngeina uh TOUPA a dia gimlim ding a mei a thillatte sim louh in.
english: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and the meal offering of it, and the continual burnt offering and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: "Hiai akha sagihna, ani sawm ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding uh. Na hinna uh zangsak in nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Tatna Ni Thilpiak / (Lev 23.26-32)
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; and you shall afflict your souls: you shall do no kind of work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahih ding ahi.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

paite: Belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat toh; kilemna dia khelh thoihna, halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat uh sim louh in.
english: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.

paite: "Akha sagihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei, TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung ankuang na lui ding uh ahi.
heading: Biakbuk Ankuangluina A Thillat / (Lev 23.33-44)
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work, and you shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days:

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat, halmang thillat na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai sawm-le-thum, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-li, huaite gensiatbei chiat ahih ding uh ahi:
english: and you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh sathau toh helkhawm bawngtal sawm-le-thum, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa nih, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,

paite: Belamnou sawm-le-li, belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani nih ni in bawngtaltuai sawm-le-nih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li na lat ding uh ahi.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat a dan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat, dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.

paite: "Ani thum ni in bawngtal sawm-le-khat, belampa nih, belamnou kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh huai adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani li ni in bawngtal sawm, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani nga ni in bawngtal kua, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani guk ni in bawngtal giat, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding;
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offerings of it.

paite: "Ani sagih ni in bawngtal sagih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani giat ni in khawmpi siangthoutak na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no servile work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi. Bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: "Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un,
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Na thuchiamte uh, ut thu a thillatte, na halmang thillatte uh, na tangbuang thillatte uh, na dawn thillatte uh, na kilemna thillatte uh sim louh in hiaite ankuangluina hunbi nei a na neihte uh ni in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uhi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng Mosi in Israel suante ahilh hi.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
